issue_text: In shardResultBlockers, a result is matched to a shard by its content hash (MatchShard), giving id = "shard-"+shard.ID. The guard at lines 419-422 (`if strings.TrimSpace(result.ShardID) != id`) is the ONLY check that the result's self-declared ShardID field actually equals the shard its hash belongs to. It is deletable with every test still passing: no test asserts the blocker it emits ("... declares shard ..."). Grep confirms the literal "declares shard" appears only in manifest.go, never in a test.

validRationale returns false for len(value) < 12 at line 613, THEN switches on lowercased value rejecting "n/a", "none", "to"+"do" (="todo"), "tbd" at lines 616-621. All four literals are 3-4 characters, strictly less than 12, so the length guard already returns false before any of them can reach the switch. The switch's reject cases are unreachable dead code; the switch can be deleted with all tests passing.

severityBlocks (line 646) excludes SeverityLow from the blocking set, so a low-severity finding with an open/waived/deferred disposition does not block a PASS. No test pins this exclusion: every test that uses SeverityLow pairs it with another blocker (unknown disposition, missing evidence) or a closing disposition. severityBlocks could be changed to treat low as blocking (e.g. `value != ""`) and the entire suite still passes.
